description_en: Retrieve a paginated list of deployment processes. You can also filter this list based on specific criteria
description_zh: 分页获取发布流程列表，也可以使用筛选条件对发布流程进行筛选
name: ListPipelineRuns

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can obtain this ID from the Workspace Management page in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console).

This parameter specifies the DataWorks workspace to use for the API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by the creator of the pipeline
parameters.help_zh: 筛选条件：发布流程的创建者
parameters.name: creator

parameters.help_en:
Filters the results by the current status of the pipeline.

Valid values:

`Init`: initializing

`Running`: running

`Success`: succeeded

`Fail`: failed

`Termination`: terminated

`Cancel`: canceled
parameters.help_zh:
筛选条件：发布流程的当前状态

可选值：

Init 初始化
Running 运行中
Success 运行成功
Fail 运行失败
Termination 被终止
Cancel 被取消
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size
